reviews.author: norma daniela lepe trillo
reviews.text: Everything was perfect since i walked in, Aylinn was a big help while i was going through the menu and the cooks (Fabian and Iracema) did an awesome job cuz it was delicious 💕

reviews.author: Anthony Wong
reviews.text:
I’ve been coming here for over 10 years and even through COVID. The BEST fish tacos I’ve had from LA to SD. The fish, the hours, and not to even mention the price. You can’t beat the tacos, the quality and the service! Aylin and Noé are always serving with a smile!

I’ll always be coming back and highly recommend this place for the best fish tacos in SoCal period!

reviews.author: Fabiana Marques
reviews.text:
Paid $22 for this burrito and chips and honestly it was one of the worst takeout experiences I’ve had. The burrito was poorly rolled, falling apart, had way too much tortilla and barely any filling inside. The food had no flavor or seasoning at all and was honestly terrible.

I called asking for a refund and they told me they would not refund my money unless I drove back there with the receipt. The problem is this was a to-go order and by the time I opened the food, I was already 20 minutes away on the freeway, so going back was not realistic.

I also asked if there was a number or email where I could send photos and make a complaint, and they basically told me there was nothing they could do and that I could leave a bad Google review if I wanted.

Terrible customer service, overpriced food, and horrible quality. I will literally never go back there again and I do not recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: せんぱい.
reviews.text: Been coming to this spot pretty regularly and man they never miss, the fish tacos are always so damn good. I even got hooked up with a free drink as a token of appreciation since I promised to write a genuine review whenever I had time. If you ever want to eat some amazing fish tacos, these are probably the best in town especially for the price. The customer service is also amazing, everyone seems to be very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Marcel Chambers
reviews.text: Free fish taco today and looking forward to the andobado and carnitas quesadillas! Ripping good gas prices and a car wash while having a delicious lunch. Feels like a So Cal Sunday.

reviews.author: Jane Chang Bright
reviews.text: Dude. I would give 10 stars if I could! This place was highly recommended by a friend so we came the next time we were down this way. $1.39 fish tacos and there's no limit!!! The best fish tacos I've had, hands down! They need to open one closer to me!! The Paloma was really tasty, too! We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Nekaiya Wilson
reviews.text: El Pueblo is truly a gem! The prices are amazing, the customer service is always warm and welcoming, and the food comes out incredibly fast. You really can’t beat the turnaround time or the value. Misael and J are both so kind, professional, and attentive—they make the experience even better every time we visit!

reviews.author: Tori Farris
reviews.text: Quick, easy, and delicious dinner! I’ve been going here for their $1 fish tacos (now $1.39, but I think I can afford the increase) since I was a kid. Went back to visit my hometown and had to come here. Quality still as good as I remember as a kid! Iker and Jeremiah were super helpful at the cashiers. 10/10 recommend for a quick, affordable lunch or dinner.

reviews.author: Jo M
reviews.text: I used to order from here a lot, but it’s been a while. I recently ordered fish tacos with a side of fries. The fish tacos were on point and really good. However, I was disappointed with the fries — for $4.19, the portion was very small and barely filled the container. Definitely not worth the price.

reviews.author: Carlos Robles
reviews.text: This is a must if you are in the area!  The fish tacos are so delicious! And you can't beat the price anywhere on southern california! Every time I am in Carlsbad, I stop by El Pueblo! 5 stars all the way!🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟

carmel-valley.name: El Pueblo Mexican Food & Bar - Carmel Valley

reviews.author: Brandon Nolte
reviews.text: I underestimated this place. The meats were well seasoned, the taco bar was thoughtfully stocked, and the staff was warm and efficient. For the quality, it is an excellent value. The only puzzling note was the generic signage out front, which hides a spot that deserves to be known by name.

reviews.author: em
reviews.text: There was a crumpled receipt with a time stamp of like three hours ago wrapped inside my taco. Service is really bad when the guy manager isn’t there. Dine in order was packaged as a to go order and never brought out until we went to ask about our food being ready.

reviews.author: Andrew Barrera
reviews.text: Cherry was most helpfully with ordering. Wasn’t sure what to get since it was our first time here. Recommend the fish tacos! Delicious!!!

reviews.author: Kristen Rivera
reviews.text:
We are new to the area and have been searching for somewhere to make our "regular" place for date night. We definitely lucked out eating here!

Giovanna made our experience so special. Our service was prompt, polite, and consistent. We never had to worry about looking for refills or extras during the meal. Her presence let us enjoy the food, atmosphere, each other's company.

Would definitely recommend! We'll be back.

reviews.author: Amy Y
reviews.text: This is now one of my favorite fish taco places. You can't beat the price AND quality. The taco portions are huge! No skimping on the fish and both the corn and flour tortillas are so good. I managed to eat 4 tacos but I could have happily stopped at 3. The pickled carrots at the salsa bar were deliciously tangy and crunchy as well as a side, it's a perfect complement to the tacos. Loved everything about this place!

del-mar.name: El Pueblo Mexican Food & Bar - Del Mar

reviews.author: Alaura S.
reviews.text:
Hadn’t been here since it was the make-your-own pizza place — I can’t believe they’ve been here for 8 years now!
We sat at the (small) bar and totally lucked out with Joe as our bartender. He was awesome — super attentive, checked in on us (and everyone) often, and provided fast service. You can tell he really cares about the patrons. He also makes great drinks. The Paloma is one of his specialties, and I also tried the Siesta from their feature menu of the month (Jan 2026), which was really good. I was a little hesitant to try the Paloma because some places make it too tart, but his was very well balanced. Same with the Siesta — I thought it might be lime-forward and tart, but it was surprisingly smooth and balanced.
They have a full bar, so if you’re not into beer, there are plenty of other options. They also have an outdoor patio area, which is great for families or kids’ sports teams after a game.
Good Mexican food without restaurant-level prices. I’d say it’s like an upscale taco shop, but better. The staff is really nice and friendly, and there are lots of regulars. They also have TVs in the bar area and show UFC fights, so check their website for details.
It does get really busy, which is great for the business, but they have a good system to move people along. You order at the front, and if the bar area isn’t too busy, they’ll call you over and assist with your order. They currently have happy hour every day from 2pm–7pm and again from 11pm–12am for late-night happy hour.
Great place to go!

reviews.author: Susy Davis
reviews.text:
The food and drinks are fantastic here!  I really have to give a shout-out to Kameron. Every single time we come here, he’s so friendly and outgoing, he just has a way of making everyone feel welcome the second they walk in.
I’m always impressed by how hard he works; he’s constantly on the move but still takes the time to give the best recommendations and make sure we’re totally taken care of. It’s rare to find someone with that kind of work ethic and attitude. He’s a true pleasure to deal with every visit. Honestly, give that young man a raise! He definitely deserves it.

Owen is another rockstar on the team! He’s super sharp, attentive, and always makes sure we have everything we need. It’s the great service and hard work from guys like Owen that keeps us coming back. He really does a fantastic job!

reviews.author: E M
reviews.text: 1st time here and will be returning for sure! The fish tacos were amazing and the best price in town! Only $1.39 per fish taco! Unbelievable!  I ordered 3 and made it a combo by adding side or rice and beans. All under $10!  They have a salsa bar and a nice selection of drinks. Including horchata and Jamaica water! There's indoor seating. And covered patio.seating as well . Its right off.  Location is also convenient close to the 5 fwy!

reviews.author: Sage Maguro
reviews.text: You can’t beat $1.39 fish tacos.  They are the best!  The salsa bar is an added bonus!  Flour tortillas in tacos are always great!  One small ding in my order where I ordered two fish tacos and received one instead, so check your orders.

reviews.author: Lisa Dean-Storer
reviews.text: Good vibe, good food, friendly staff. Joe, at the bar, took care of us with mimosas while we waited for our take out order. Joe, is super friendly, excellent eye contact, and came over to wipe our table down and brought our drinks to us. SWEET!

la-jolla.name: El Pueblo Mexican Food - La Jolla

reviews.author: Chris Wood
reviews.text: This is such a nice restaurant. The prices are great and Carlos is one of the nicest person on earth. He helped me so much with my order and I am so happy that I’m gonna be here more get that one dollar 50 Cent taco

reviews.author: Rosa Rodriguez
reviews.text: This place is a yumi, I work Prety close from the restaurant and it’s my favorite place to eat for lunch, muy rico👌Frankie gave me a very good costumer service he was very polite and friendly😊 thank you all…

reviews.author: Leslie Saenz
reviews.text: Do NOT miss out on the beans.  We bought some to take home.  Ate dinner here and then lunch the next day.  Where can you get 2 fish tacos, beans and a drink for $6.21.  HERE!!  The protein bowl, chicken taco and shredded beef taco were also delish!!

reviews.author: Louis Zarour
reviews.text: THE NEW GO-TO SPOT IN LA JOLLA. The food was amazing, the parking lot was super convenient, indoor and outdoor seating, and most of all the service was great! Now we have the best Mexican food for beach days in La Jolla, I recommend the fish tacos and the carne asada quesadillas!

reviews.author: Rad Train
reviews.text: California burrito, sub par. $18 for a pinner California that just does not do it. Standard school pencil is longer and thats saying something. Taste was nothing special. Try don Carlos up the street for real authentic Mexican food and more.
